subject: Re: Saturday shed cleanup notes
text: Sorry to jump back into this before I have a cup of coffee, but I just tried to forward the Saturday shed cleanup notes and noticed that the attachment mentioned in your last message is nowhere to be found. I checked the shared folder, my downloads, the old photo folder, and even the cluttered drawer by the kitchen table where I keep every stray note. I am sure it was supposed to show up with the measurements for the shelf boards and the short list of tools we still need to borrow from the side shed. I did not want to start measuring anything without seeing the diagram, because last time we improvised the spacing looked fine until we tried to slide the tall bin under the workbench, and it ended up sticking out by several inches. If you can resend it, I will match it against the lumber tags we bought yesterday. If the file is gone, I can sketch what I remember from the afternoon conversation, but my memory is already hazy and I would rather compare yours to mine before we move the heavy shelves and end up needing to cut a second piece. In the meantime, I labeled the four shelf brackets with masking tape, so if one drawing comes back different we can quickly see which hole pattern belongs to the long side.
